Hmm, the PLAN input I built only has 2 bursts with 0 addresses (my script had a bug: `if vv==len(hists) and False`). So the DP ran with no burst data → fast but not representative. The T/Q values are all 0, so the DP is trivial (all nodes have work 0 → just minimize pages).

Let me build a proper worst-case PLAN input: 2 versions with R=64, 128 bursts with 64 addresses each, cache_pages=12, hit=16, miss=256, decode=[16,16,16].

Let me write it properly.

cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF' > /tmp/plan_in.txt
import sys, json, random, ipaddress, bisect
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import test_scale as TS
rng=random.Random(99)
case=TS.big_case(rng)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from protocol import parse_request
from reference import reference_runs
req=parse_request(json.dumps({'cases':[case]}).encode())[0]
fib={}
for route,hop in req['initial']: fib[route]=hop
hists=[dict(fib)]
for tx in req['transactions']:
    for op,route,hop in tx:
        if op=='set': fib[route]=hop
        elif route in fib: del fib[route]
    hists.append(dict(fib))
print('PLAN %d %d %d %d %d %d %d'%(len(hists),12,16,256,16,16,16))
for vi,v in enumerate(hists):
    starts,hops=reference_runs(v)
    lines=[str(len(starts))]
    lines+=['%032x %d'%(s,-1 if h is None else h) for s,h in zip(starts,hops)]
    bl=[(rep,[bisect.bisect_right(starts,int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a)))-1 for a in addrs]) for vv,rep,addrs in req['bursts'] if vv==vi]
    lines.append(str(len(bl)))
    for rep,runs_of in bl:
        lines.append('%d %d%s'%(rep,len(runs_of),''.join(' %d'%x for x in runs_of)))
    print('\n'.join(lines))
PYEOF
wc -l /tmp/plan_in.txt; head -2 /tmp/plan_in.txt; time /workspace/tmp/engine < /tmp/plan_in.txt > /tmp/plan_out.txt; head -2 /tmp/plan_out.txt; grep -c . /tmp/plan_out.txt
